profile_text.body:
Autodesk is a public company traded under the ticker ADSK, with SEC filings recorded under CIK 0000769397. Its website presents Tinkercad, which it describes as a free, easy-to-use app for 3D design, electronics, and coding.

Tinkercad is listed among education and research AI products. No AI features are recorded for it. Its stated uses are 3D design, circuits, and code blocks, and its stated audience is students and teachers, of all ages, with under 13 requiring parent or teacher consent and teacher-linked class accounts available. The product is free, is described as kidSAFE COPPA Safe Harbor certified, and is covered by an Autodesk Children's Privacy Statement dated April 2026.

No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
